instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Join trips and drivers returning all child rows with parent name
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Left join trips to drivers keeping all trips rows
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c LEFT JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Right join trips to drivers keeping all drivers rows
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c RIGHT JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Count trips records per name
output: SELECT p.name, COUNT(c.id) FROM drivers p LEFT JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id GROUP BY p.name;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Sum fare per name
output: SELECT p.name, SUM(c.fare) FROM drivers p JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id GROUP BY p.name;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
drivers rows that have no matching trips
output: SELECT p.name FROM drivers p LEFT JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id WHERE c.id IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Full outer join trips and drivers
output: SELECT * FROM trips c FULL OUTER JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Cross join trips and drivers
output: SELECT * FROM trips CROSS JOIN drivers;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Join and filter trips rows where fare > 100
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id WHERE c.fare > 100;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Average fare per name for name having more than 3 children
output: SELECT p.name, AVG(c.fare) FROM drivers p JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 3;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Max fare per name
output: SELECT p.name, MAX(c.fare) FROM drivers p JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id GROUP BY p.name;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Rows joining a city starting with 'N' in name
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE 'N%';

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Join with alias and order by fare desc
output: SELECT c.id, p.name AS detail, c.fare FROM trips c JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id ORDER BY c.fare DESC;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Left join showing nulls for name when unmatched
output: SELECT c.*, p.name FROM trips c LEFT JOIN drivers p ON c.driver_id = p.id;

instruction:
Schema: trips(id, driver_id, fare) and drivers(id, name)
Grouped join returning count and sum together
output: SELECT p.name, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt, SUM(COALESCE(c.fare,0)) AS tot FROM drivers p LEFT JOIN trips c ON p.id = c.driver_id GROUP BY p.name;
